name: git
description: Multi-repository Git development environment for Obsidian

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:source && npm run typecheck:tests && npm run typecheck:invariants
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:architecture
scripts.test:architecture: npm run dependency:test && vitest run tests/architecture && npm run typecheck:invariants
scripts.build: npm run typecheck:source && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:architecture && npm run test:integration && npm run test:safety && npm run build
